expectations.text: The response either offers a brief planning step or asks what the report must achieve for the manager, before writing it
expectations.evidence: Before the template, it proposes gathering facts and then drafting: “我可以直接给你一份结构，你把事实填进去；如果你把要点告诉我，我也可以帮你写成成稿。”

expectations.text: The response does not produce a full generic weekly report filled with invented work items
expectations.evidence: The report contains blank placeholders such as “【事项】：做了什么 → 进展/结果” and requests “本周实际做成的 3–5 件事”; sample achievements are explicitly writing examples.
